name: Odwa Dilizo
qualifications: LLB, Certificate in Advanced Corporate Law and Securities Law, Certificate in Compliance Management, PGD BA
membership: Legal Practice Council, Association of Arbitrators (Southern Africa) NPC
projects: Project representative and legal advisor to the PropWatch and PropSol joint ventures.
bio: Odwa holds an LLB from Nelson Mandela University and is admitted as an attorney of the High Court of South Africa. He has also completed a postgraduate diploma in business management, and is currently training in dispute resolution for the construction industry.

He spent five years as head of the land acquisition team and legal expert to the land-legal team for the Greater Edendale and Vulindlela Development Initiative, the inter-governmental programme to redevelop Edendale in Pietermaritzburg, and served as property manager for the MAJV, the GeoAfrika-led property portfolio service provider to SANRAL, covering property management, identification and acquisition.

Odwa’s work is largely in public law: assisting municipalities with land tenure and the acquisition of land in urban, rural and tribal areas for large-scale developments, and drafting agreements, policies and guidelines for state-owned enterprises. He is the service providers’ representative for the PropWatch and PropSol joint ventures’ contracts with SANRAL.
